prompt: Telegram bot webhook debugging with missing screenshots, error logs, and exact payload

assertions.name: identifies-missing-resources
assertions.description: Output explicitly lists what information is missing (error logs, screenshots, exact payload)

assertions.name: does-not-fabricate-screenshots
assertions.description: Does NOT include a fake screenshot path or pretend a screenshot exists

assertions.name: does-not-invent-data
assertions.description: Does NOT invent Telegram payload structure or Vercel dashboard data

assertions.name: marks-placeholders
assertions.description: If writing with gaps, marks missing parts with @user or TODO comments

assertions.name: asks-user-for-input
assertions.description: Specifically asks user to provide missing items before completing the article
